sections.title: Life cycle and form
sections.text: Soybean is an upright annual, usually 60 cm to 1.8 m tall, and widely cultivated. Its leaves are trifoliate and its small white to purple flowers are inconspicuous.

sections.title: Pods and seeds
sections.text: The hairy pods are about 2–7 cm long and usually contain two or three seeds, sometimes up to five.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: Mature seeds are eaten after cooking and processed into many foods; immature seeds are also eaten as edamame after cooking.
